subject.title: Backup verification fails on long Windows SQLite paths

question: Should the backup owner prioritize a focused Windows long-path repair now and confirm the intended shared SQLite filename-normalization boundary across backup and snapshot verification?
rationale: The report is precise, but the correct shared ownership boundary and Windows validation coverage require the responsible maintainer to inspect the current backup and snapshot implementation before implementation is dispatched.
